verdict_reason: c-094's rewritten outcome is right on paging at eight, but it contradicts the stale req-594 and req-595 in the same area file, and it claims role filtering for the consignment contact picker, which does not filter by role.

todos.issue: c-094's outcome (line 2437) now says req-594 and req-595 build paging at eight and the 'Selected address' inset, but the same file's req-594 (line 926) still says 'lists every address it offers on one page, with no pagination' and req-595 (line 993) still says the pickers 'no longer show a Selected address inset', with whys citing ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm. The PR rewrote both in distil/requirements.json but not in this area file, so the area file contradicts itself and disagrees with requirements.json. DISTIL.md step 5 builds requirements.json from these area files with tim distil merge-reconcile, so re-running the merge brings the one-page, no-inset wording back, which the ticket's AC ('so a re-distil does not drop paging again') rules out.
todos.fix: Must: this area file's req-594 and req-595 statement and why match distil/requirements.json word for word (eight a page with GOV.UK pagination, inset restored, ruling ian-2026-11-23), so c-094's outcome and the requirements it cites agree, and a re-merge of the areas gives the same requirements.json. One way: copy the two rewritten requirement entries from requirements.json into this file and check with tim distil merge-reconcile --area consignment-parties.

todos.issue: c-094's new outcome says the pickers built on 'plants' consignor, place of destination and consignment contact pickers' show 'eight of the role's addresses a page ... landing with role filtering (req-608)'. The consignment contact picker is not role-filtered: its spec (openspec/specs/plants/journey-pages/consignment-contact-select/spec.md, REQ-PLANTS-CONTACT-SELECT-001, changed in this PR) offers 'the address book' and shows 'up to eight of the addresses the organisation holds', and req-608 (line 1365) covers only plants' consignor and place of destination. The outcome therefore claims role filtering where none is built or required. The identical sentence is in distil/conflicts.json line 3238.
todos.fix: Must: c-094's outcome, here and in distil/conflicts.json, says the consignment contact picker pages the organisation's whole address book at eight, and ties role filtering (req-608) only to the pickers req-608 names. One way: split the sentence, e.g. 'eight of the role's addresses a page on the role-filtered pickers (req-608), and eight of the whole book a page on plants' consignment contact picker'.
